specsHeading: Income Tax e-Filing Portal Attachment Limits.

sections.heading: Income Tax portal document submission rules.
body: When responding to e-Proceedings, Section 143(1) / 148 notices, or attaching Form 16 and bank statements on incometax.gov.in, each individual PDF must not exceed 5 MB.
Scanned annual bank statements or multi-page tax audit books easily reach 15–30 MB. Zcompressor compresses these documents under 5 MB while maintaining financial table legibility.

faq.q: What is the attachment limit on the Income Tax e-Filing portal?
faq.a: The maximum file size for a single PDF attachment on the Income Tax e-Filing portal is 5 MB, with up to 10 PDF attachments permitted per response.
